Then apply the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a). Calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac) to determine the nature of the roots—real or complex.

Stationary points occur where the derivative f'(x) equals zero. First, compute the derivative of f(x). Then set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. Finally, check the second derivative (f''(x)) at those points to classify them as maxima or minima.
